phaseDetail: The November 9 DOJ filing reports $1.232 billion in approved offers, $981 million paid and 3,802 cumulative federal complaints. settlements.label: Elective Option and CLJA settlement activity
settlements.amount: $1.232 billion in approved offers and $981 million paid as reported November 9, 2026
settlements.detail: The November 9 DOJ filing reports $1.232 billion in approved offers, $981 million paid and 3,802 cumulative federal complaints. Elective Option amounts depend on diagnosis and exposure tiers, and individual payment depends on eligibility and completed documents.
settlements.individualClaims: DOJ says accepted EO offers can be paid within 60 days or less with timely, accurate payment documents. That is not a deadline for receiving an offer. Its current notice says EO determinations are not being reconsidered and additional EO documentation is not accepted; payment paperwork is a separate step.

keyDates.label: Updated aggregate settlement reporting

deadlineOverride: The Navy stopped accepting new Camp Lejeune Justice Act administrative claims after August 10, 2024. State personal-injury deadlines do not reopen that federal window. A timely administrative claim does not eliminate later deadlines following denial, court orders or settlement offers; the notice and individual claim history need separate review.
